title: TryAL task metadata
description: Schema for tasks/<task-id>/metadata.yaml. The format contract is owned by the platform; do not change field names, enums, or semantics unilaterally.

id.description: Task id. Must equal the directory name. Kebab-case; convention: <topic>-<slug>.

title.description: Display title shown in the catalog.

author.description: Optional display credit, e.g. "@your-github-handle". Courtesy only — legal attribution lives in git history and the repository LICENSE (MIT). There is no per-task license field.

topic.description: Must be an id defined in topics.yaml.

executionTier.description: compile_only: success is exactly zero compiler errors. full_execution: graded by the [Test] procedures in tests/. NOTE: this catalog currently accepts only full_execution (lint-enforced repo policy); compile_only remains in the platform format for the future.

transactionModel.description: full_execution only. Declares whether the test run rolls back all its writes. Never affects pass/fail; only feeds the companyIsolation: reuse decision.

companyIsolation.description: full_execution only. reuse allows grading in a shared warm company when the submission is provably rollback-safe (automatic fallback to fresh). Set fresh if the tests commit data.

bcVersion.description: Omit. Defaults from the platform's pinned BC version; only set for a deliberate exception.

runtime.description: Omit. Defaults from the platform's pinned BC version; only set for a deliberate exception.

target.description: Omit. Defaults to Cloud; only set for a deliberate exception.

transactionModel.description: transactionModel applies to full_execution tasks only.
